module_summary: Direct-mapped write-through cache controller: a 5-state FSM latches CPU requests, checks tag/valid arrays for hit, refills or writes memory via req/ack, then responds.

anchors.name: state_q
anchors.why: IDLE/LOOKUP/WRITE_MEM/REFILL/RESPOND controller; decodes all handshakes and array writes.

anchors.name: tag_array
anchors.why: Per-line tag storage compared for hit, written on refill.

anchors.name: data_array
anchors.why: Cached data lines; read on hit, written on refill or write hit.

anchors.name: valid_bits
anchors.why: Per-line valid bits set on refill, qualify the hit compare.

anchors.name: hit
anchors.why: Tag match flag steering LOOKUP to RESPOND/REFILL and gating write-hit updates.

anchors.name: index
anchors.why: Line index from addr_q addressing tag, data and valid arrays.

anchors.name: addr_q
anchors.why: Latched request address supplying index, tag and mem_addr.

anchors.name: wdata_q
anchors.why: Latched write data driving mem_wdata and write-hit update.

anchors.name: we_q
anchors.why: Latched write command choosing WRITE_MEM path in LOOKUP.

anchors.name: cpu_req_valid
anchors.why: CPU request valid; starts lookup and latches request in IDLE.

anchors.name: cpu_req_ready
anchors.why: Request ready while FSM is IDLE.

anchors.name: cpu_addr
anchors.why: CPU request address latched into addr_q.

anchors.name: cpu_we
anchors.why: Read/write command latched into we_q.

anchors.name: cpu_wdata
anchors.why: CPU write data latched into wdata_q.

anchors.name: cpu_resp_valid
anchors.why: One-cycle response valid in RESPOND state with read data.

anchors.name: cpu_rdata
anchors.why: Response data from rdata_q (hit, refill or written data).

anchors.name: stall_o
anchors.why: Stall level while FSM is busy, outside IDLE and RESPOND.

anchors.name: mem_req
anchors.why: Memory request in REFILL or WRITE_MEM states.

anchors.name: mem_we
anchors.why: Memory write indication decoded from WRITE_MEM state.

anchors.name: mem_ack
anchors.why: Memory acknowledge advancing FSM and enabling refill/write updates.

anchors.name: mem_rdata
anchors.why: Refill data written into data_array and rdata_q.

groups.name: cache_fsm
groups.description: Lookup/refill/write/respond controller driven by hit and mem_ack.

groups.name: cache_arrays
groups.description: Tag, data and valid arrays indexed by request address.

groups.name: request_latch
groups.description: Holding registers for address, write data, write flag and read data.

groups.name: mem_port
groups.description: Memory req/ack interface for refill and write-through.
